text:
二氢吡啶类钙通道阻滞剂等，其中高风险药物相互作用共 902 例次，占 66.96%。结论克拉霉素在门诊患者中发生潜在药物相互作用现象较普遍，临床医师应权衡利弊，优化药物治疗方案，药师应通过专项培训、前置处方审核等进行干预，保障患者用药安全。Retrospective investigation and countermeasures for potential drug-drug interactions involving clarithromycin in outpatients of a hospital
CAO Di, CHENG Jun (Department of Pharmacy, the Third People’s Hospital of Bengbu, Bengbu Anhui 233000)Abstract: Objective To determine the drug interactions involving clarithromycin in outpatients in a hospital and provide reference for rational drug use. Methods We retrospectively analyzed the potential drug interactions in outpatient prescriptions of clarithromycin from August 2022 to July 2023 in our hospital, based on the clarithromycin package insert and with reference to relevant literature and professional databases. Results Totally 7470 prescriptions of clarithromycin were included, covering 1171 cases (1347 interactions) of potential drug interactions, with an incidence of 15.68%. The interactions involved 45 drugs, primarily xanthine bronchodilators, glucocorticoids, QTprolonging drugs, HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors, and dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers. Among them, 902 interactions were classified as high-risk, accounting for 66.96% of the total. Conclusion Potential drug interactions involving clarithromycin are relatively common among outpatients. Clinicians should weigh the benefits and drawbacks and optimize treatment regimens. Pharmacists should intervene through specialized training and pre-prescription review to ensure patient medication safety.据调查，临床上超过30%的药品不良反应（adverse reaction，ADR）是由药物相互作用（drug-drug interaction，DDI）引起的，严重威胁患者的安全，导致患者住院时间延长、医疗成本增加，而DDI往往可以预防和避免，药师通过发挥自身专业优势对临床中出现的DDI进行鉴别和评估，有利于帮助医师对诊疗中出现的DDI进行管理[1-2]。
